title: Migrate old game exports to server-log-based format
description:
Game exports in `website/public/games/` still use the old spectator-based format (no top-level `version` field) and should be migrated to the server-log-based format (version 2) as best as possible. Some data like full hand contents, P/T on permanents, mana pools, and visible_to annotations won't be recoverable from spectator logs. After migration, remove support for the old spectator format from `scripts/export_game.py`.

Revalidated on 2026-02-22: still relevant. Current tree has many legacy exports without a version field (232 files at audit time: 229 `.json.gz` + 3 `.json`).
